description: PRIMARY ENTRY TOOL for a natural-language problem, desired outcome, or need when the user has not named a specific Evercraft product. Route the intent to the smallest current public-safe capability. Use discover_offers only for explicit catalog browsing and get_offer only after a match. Results may be sell-now or discovery-only; read commercial_state and invocation_status before any next step. Returns no result when confidence is too weak. Read-only; never purchases or starts checkout.
